players.name: Raleigh/Jeffers
players.summary: Ryan Jeffers (MIN) is on the 60-day IL with a fractured left hamate. Underwent surgery May 19; expected return in 6–8 weeks. Alex Jackson recalled from Triple-A as replacement.

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper went 0-for-3 with an RBI in PHI's game vs CLE on May 24. No injury concerns.

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez had 1 hit in 3 AB in SFG's win over CWS, snapping a 6-game losing streak. Season AVG sits at .322.

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 1-for-4 vs MIA. Day-to-day with a lingering PCL sprain in his left knee dating to September 2025; playing through it.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle (DET) went 2-for-4 with a run and 2 RBI in DET's win over BAL. Solid young contributor holding his own at SS.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA went 0-for-3 with a sacrifice fly RBI in CHC's 8-5 loss to HOU. Cubs continue to struggle in the NL Central.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill (SDP) sat out May 24 with sore ribs from a wall collision on May 20. Listed day-to-day; expected to return early this week.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Teoscar went 1-for-3 with a run scored in LAD's 5-1 win over MIL. No injury concerns.

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice (NYY) went 0-for-3 in NYY's 2-0 shutout win over TBR. Defensive contributions solid but bat still searching for consistency.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams was roughed up vs MIA: 1/3 IP, 2 H, 4 ER, 2 BB — took the loss. Season ERA climbs to 6.23. Command has been shaky.

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler did not pitch May 24 (started Sat May 23 vs CLE, earned his 6th win). Season ERA now 1.41 over 51 IP — dominant all spring.

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans remains on the 15-day IL with left elbow VEO/impingement. Completed Triple-A rehab; return from IL appears imminent this week.

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns did not pitch May 24; CIN vs STL was rained out. Maintaining a sterling 1.99 ERA over 59.67 IP.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi did not pitch May 24 (started Sat May 23). Season ERA now 3.67 over 68.67 IP; consistent innings-eater.

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan was not scheduled to pitch May 24. Season ERA 4.93 over 45.67 IP; recent starts trending better.

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers was outstanding: 8 IP, 1 H, 1 ER, career-high 14 K, 0 BB in LAA's 2-1 walk-off win over TEX. No decision but an absolute gem — ERA drops to 4.87.
